chronicConditions.name: Epilepsy, focal with secondary generalization
chronicConditions.notes: Last seizure 14 months ago. Triggered historically by sleep deprivation and heat. On dual AED therapy with good control.

chronicConditions.name: Chronic Kidney Disease, Stage 3a
chronicConditions.notes: eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73m² at last check. Likely secondary to long-term anticonvulsant exposure and recurrent UTIs. Followed by nephrology in Karachi.

allergies.reaction: Severe diffuse rash with facial swelling

surgeries.notes: Acute cholecystitis with gallstones. Uncomplicated recovery.

clinicalNotes.author: Dr. Sana Iqbal, Neurology — Aga Khan University Hospital
clinicalNotes.content: Pre-Hajj review. EEG (Feb 2025) shows no epileptiform activity. Reviewed seizure precautions in heat: hydrate aggressively, ensure 7+ hours sleep, never miss AED doses. Provided written Urdu instructions for companions on seizure first aid. Renal panel stable — continue current Lasix dose.

clinicalNotes.author: Dr. Tariq Mahmood, Nephrology
clinicalNotes.content: CKD stable. Cautioned re: NSAIDs and contrast. Patient counseled — carries allergy bracelet. eGFR 52, creatinine 1.3. Continue current regimen.
